mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4% triggers a loss of consumer confidence and reduced corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not decline significantly (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in GDP (GDPC1) signal accommodative monetary policy and robust economic growth, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases >0.5% and GDPC1 increases >1% in the prior month
failure_condition: Proxies move in opposite directions or 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle inflationary expansion regime, rising CPIAUCSL indices below 2% indicate controlled price pressures, fostering investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL spikes above 2% or 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in supply-side indicators (INDPRO) and demand-side activity (HOUST) reflects healthy economic expansion, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations to drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases >1% and HOUST increases >0.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: Proxies move in opposite directions or 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An abrupt increase in labor turnover (PAYEMS) above 1.5% signals labor market instability, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not exceed 1.5% or 20-day returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDP (GDPC1) growth indicates robust demand for goods and services, enhancing corporate earnings and equity valuations to produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not show upward trend or 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase, sustained growth in GDP (GDPC1) reflects improving economic conditions, fostering investor optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth does not align with recovery trajectory or 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
